note: Runs the whole agent on a bundled month (September 2569): three purchase orders, two goods receipts and three invoices. Five goods lines are tested three-way against their receipts, the consultancy line is a service and is tested two-way — and the working paper says so on the line, in the summary and on its face. Every link is made by rule (the PO number and the PO line), nothing is asked, all three invoices pass, and the real working paper is shown before the user trusts the agent with their own files.
